questions.text: यदि α तथा β, बहुपद 3x² + 6x + k के शून्यक हैं तथा α + β + αβ = −2/3 है, तो k का मान है:
questions.text_english: If α and β are the zeroes of polynomial 3x² + 6x + k such that α + β + αβ = −2/3, then the value of k is:
questions.solution: For polynomial 3x² + 6x + k, by Vieta's formulas: α + β = −6/3 = −2 and αβ = k/3. Given α + β + αβ = −2/3, substituting: −2 + k/3 = −2/3, so k/3 = −2/3 + 2 = 4/3, therefore k = 4. Option (D) is correct. Options A, B, C give incorrect values when substituted back into the condition.
questions.solution_hindi: बहुपद 3x² + 6x + k के लिए, वीएटा सूत्र से: α + β = −6/3 = −2 तथा αβ = k/3। दी गई शर्त α + β + αβ = −2/3 में रखने पर: −2 + k/3 = −2/3, अतः k/3 = 4/3, इसलिए k = 4।

questions.text: यदि x = 1 तथा y = 2, रैखिक समीकरण युग्म 2x − 3y + a = 0 तथा 2x + 3y − b = 0 का एक हल है, तो:
questions.text_english: If x = 1 and y = 2 is a solution of the pair of linear equations 2x − 3y + a = 0 and 2x + 3y − b = 0, then:
questions.solution: Substituting x = 1, y = 2 in the first equation: 2(1) − 3(2) + a = 0 → 2 − 6 + a = 0 → a = 4. Substituting in the second equation: 2(1) + 3(2) − b = 0 → 2 + 6 − b = 0 → b = 8. Checking option D: 2a + b = 2(4) + 8 = 16 ≠ 0. Checking option D again: 2(4) + 8 = 16. Let me re-verify: a = 4, b = 8, so 2a = 8 = b, thus option B (2a = b) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: x = 1, y = 2 को पहले समीकरण में रखने पर: 2 − 6 + a = 0 → a = 4। दूसरे में रखने पर: 2 + 6 − b = 0 → b = 8। अतः 2a = 8 = b, इसलिए विकल्प (B) 2a = b सही है।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
questions.topic: Solution of pair of linear equations

questions.text: बिंदुओं P(−4, 5) तथा Q(4, 6) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड का मध्य-बिंदु स्थित है:
questions.text_english: The mid-point of the line segment joining the points P(−4, 5) and Q(4, 6) lies on:

options.D: न x-अक्ष पर और न ही y-अक्ष पर

questions.solution: The mid-point of P(−4, 5) and Q(4, 6) is ((−4+4)/2, (5+6)/2) = (0, 11/2) = (0, 5.5). Since the x-coordinate is 0 and y-coordinate is non-zero, the point lies on the y-axis. Therefore option (B) is correct.

questions.text: यदि θ न्यूनकोण है तथा 7 + 4 sin θ = 9 है, तो θ का मान है:
questions.text_english: If θ is an acute angle and 7 + 4 sin θ = 9, then the value of θ is:
questions.solution: From 7 + 4 sin θ = 9, we get 4 sin θ = 2, so sin θ = 1/2. Since sin 30° = 1/2 and θ is an acute angle, θ = 30°. Option (B) is correct. At 45°, sin θ = 1/√2 ≈ 0.707 and at 60°, sin θ = √3/2 ≈ 0.866, neither equals 1/2.

questions.text: tan²θ − (1/cos θ × sec θ) का मान है:
questions.text_english: The value of tan²θ − (1/cos θ × sec θ) is:
questions.solution: We simplify tan²θ − (1/cos θ × sec θ). Since sec θ = 1/cos θ, we have (1/cos θ) × sec θ = (1/cos θ) × (1/cos θ) = 1/cos²θ = sec²θ. So the expression becomes tan²θ − sec²θ. Using the identity sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, we get tan²θ − sec²θ = −1. Therefore option (C) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: tan²θ − (1/cosθ × secθ) = tan²θ − sec²θ = −(sec²θ − tan²θ) = −1। अतः विकल्प (C) सही है।

questions.text: यदि HCF(98, 28) = m तथा LCM(98, 28) = n है, तो n − 7m का मान है:
questions.text_english: If HCF(98, 28) = m and LCM(98, 28) = n, then the value of n − 7m is:
questions.solution: First, find HCF(98, 28). 98 = 2 × 7² and 28 = 2² × 7, so HCF = 2 × 7 = 14, hence m = 14. LCM = (98 × 28)/HCF = 2744/14 = 196, hence n = 196. Therefore n − 7m = 196 − 7(14) = 196 − 98 = 98. Wait, that gives option C. Rechecking: n − 7m = 196 − 98 = 98. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: किसी वृत्त के व्यास के छोरों पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखाएँ सदैव परस्पर:
questions.text_english: The tangents drawn at the extremities of the diameter of a circle are always:
questions.solution: A tangent to a circle is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency. At the two ends of a diameter, the radii point in exactly opposite directions (180° apart), so both tangents are perpendicular to the same straight line (the diameter). Two lines both perpendicular to the same line are parallel to each other. Therefore option (A) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: स्पर्श-रेखा, त्रिज्या पर लंब होती है। व्यास के दोनों छोरों पर त्रिज्याएँ विपरीत दिशाओं में हैं, इसलिए दोनों स्पर्श-रेखाएँ समांतर होती हैं।

questions.text: त्रिभुज ABC तथा DEF में, ∠B = ∠E, ∠F = ∠C तथा AB = 3DE है, तो दोनों त्रिभुज:
questions.text_english: In triangles ABC and DEF, ∠B = ∠E, ∠F = ∠C and AB = 3DE. Then, the two triangles are:

options.A: सर्वांगसम हैं परन्तु समरूप नहीं हैं
options.C: न तो सर्वांगसम और न ही समरूप हैं
options.D: समरूप हैं परन्तु सर्वांगसम नहीं हैं

questions.solution: Since ∠B = ∠E and ∠F = ∠C, by AA similarity criterion, △ABC ~ △DEF, so the triangles are similar. However, since AB = 3DE, their corresponding sides are not equal (ratio is 3:1, not 1:1), so they are not congruent. Therefore option (D) similar but not congruent is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: ∠B = ∠E और ∠F = ∠C से AA कसौटी द्वारा △ABC ~ △DEF। लेकिन AB = 3DE होने से संगत भुजाएँ असमान हैं, अतः सर्वांगसम नहीं हैं।

questions.text_english: If (−1)ⁿ + (−1)⁸ = 0, then n is:
questions.solution: Since (−1)⁸ = 1 (even power), the equation becomes (−1)ⁿ + 1 = 0, so (−1)ⁿ = −1. This is only possible when n is an odd number, because (−1) raised to any odd power equals −1. Therefore option (C) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: (−1)⁸ = 1, इसलिए (−1)ⁿ = −1। यह तभी संभव है जब n विषम हो, क्योंकि विषम घात में (−1)ⁿ = −1। अतः विकल्प (C) सही है।

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए ग्राफ में, दो बहुपदों को दिखाया गया है। इन दोनों बहुपदों के भिन्न शून्यकों की संख्या है:
questions.text_english: Two polynomials are shown in the graph below. The number of distinct zeroes of both the polynomials is:
questions.image_description: A coordinate plane showing two polynomial curves. One appears to be a straight line crossing the x-axis at one point, and the other is a curve (likely quadratic or cubic) crossing the x-axis at two points. Together they show 3 distinct x-intercepts (zeroes).
questions.solution: The zeroes of a polynomial are the x-coordinates of the points where its graph intersects the x-axis. From the graph, one polynomial (a straight line) crosses the x-axis at 1 point, and the other polynomial (a curve) crosses the x-axis at 2 points. Together, the total number of distinct zeroes is 1 + 2 = 3. Therefore option (A) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: ग्राफ से, एक बहुपद x-अक्ष को 1 बिंदु पर और दूसरा 2 बिंदुओं पर काटता है। कुल भिन्न शून्यक = 3। अतः विकल्प (A) सही है।
questions.topic: Geometric meaning of zeroes of a polynomial

questions.text: यदि किसी समांतर श्रेढ़ी के प्रथम m पदों का योगफल 2m² + 3m है, तो इसका दूसरा पद है:
questions.text_english: If the sum of first m terms of an AP is 2m² + 3m, then its second term is:
questions.solution: Given Sₘ = 2m² + 3m. The nth term of an AP is aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁. For the second term: S₂ = 2(4) + 3(2) = 8 + 6 = 14, and S₁ = 2(1) + 3(1) = 5. Therefore a₂ = S₂ − S₁ = 14 − 5 = 9. Option (B) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: Sₘ = 2m² + 3m। दूसरा पद a₂ = S₂ − S₁ = (8+6) − (2+3) = 14 − 5 = 9। अतः विकल्प (B) सही है।
questions.topic: Sum of n terms and nth term of AP

questions.text: किन्हीं आँकड़ों के बहुलक तथा माध्य क्रमशः 15x तथा 18x हैं। तो इन आँकड़ों का माध्यक है:
questions.text_english: Mode and Mean of a data are 15x and 18x, respectively. Then the median of the data is:
questions.solution: Using the empirical relationship between mean, median, and mode: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean. Substituting: 15x = 3 × Median − 2 × 18x → 15x = 3 × Median − 36x → 3 × Median = 51x → Median = 17x. Therefore option (C) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: सूत्र: बहुलक = 3 × माध्यक − 2 × माध्य। 15x = 3 × माध्यक − 36x → माध्यक = 51x/3 = 17x। अतः विकल्प (C) सही है।
questions.topic: Empirical relationship between mean, median and mode

questions.text: ताश की 52 पत्तों की गड्डी में से यादृच्छया एक पत्ता निकाला गया। इस पत्ते के एक लाल रंग की तस्वीर वाला पत्ता होने की प्रायिकता है:
questions.text_english: A card is selected at random from a deck of 52 playing cards. The probability of it being a red face card is:
questions.solution: In a deck of 52 cards, face cards are Jack, Queen, and King — 3 in each suit. There are 2 red suits (Hearts and Diamonds), so red face cards = 3 × 2 = 6. Probability = 6/52 = 3/26. Therefore option (D) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: लाल तस्वीर वाले पत्ते = 2 रंग × 3 तस्वीर = 6। प्रायिकता = 6/52 = 3/26। अतः विकल्प (D) सही है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी परिमेय संख्या √3 तथा √5 के बीच की एक संख्या है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is a rational number between √3 and √5?
questions.solution: √3 ≈ 1.732 and √5 ≈ 2.236. The required number must be rational and lie between these two values. Option A (≈1.414) is less than √3, so it is not between them. Option B (2.3266̄...) is a repeating decimal which is rational and lies between 1.732 and 2.236 — wait, 2.326 > 2.236, so it is outside the range. Option D: 1.857142 is a terminating decimal (rational) and lies between 1.732 and 2.236. Therefore option (D) is correct.

questions.text: यदि एक वृत्त के त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल 40π वर्ग इकाई है तथा केंद्र पर बना कोण 72° है, तो वृत्त की त्रिज्या है:
questions.text_english: If a sector of a circle has an area of 40π sq. units and a central angle of 72°, the radius of the circle is:
questions.solution: Area of a sector = (θ/360°) × πr². Given area = 40π and θ = 72°: 40π = (72/360) × πr² = (1/5) × πr². Therefore r² = 40π × 5/π = 200, so r = √200 = 10√2 units. Wait, that gives option D. Rechecking: r² = 200 → r = 10√2. Therefore option (D) 10√2 units is correct.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, केंद्र O वाले वृत्त पर एक बाह्य बिंदु P से एक स्पर्श-रेखा PA खींची गई है। यदि ∠POB = 115° है, तो ∠APO बराबर है:
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PA is a tangent from an external point P to a circle with centre O. If ∠POB = 115°, then ∠APO is equal to:
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. Point P is outside the circle. PA is a tangent from P touching the circle at A. OB is a radius. The angle POB is marked as 115°.
questions.solution: Since OA ⊥ PA (radius to tangent), ∠OAP = 90°. In triangle OAP, ∠AOP + ∠OAP + ∠APO = 180°. Since B and A are on the circle and ∠POB = 115°, we need ∠POA. ∠AOB = 180° (A and B are at ends of diameter based on the figure), so ∠POA = 180° − 115° = 65°. Therefore ∠APO = 180° − 90° − 65° = 25°. Option (A) is correct.

questions.text: एक पतंग भूमि से 150 m की ऊँचाई पर उड़ रही है। यह जिस डोरी से जुड़ी है वह भूमि की क्षैतिज दिशा से 30° का कोण बनाती है। डोरी की लंबाई है:
questions.text_english: A kite is flying at a height of 150 m from the ground. It is attached to a string inclined at an angle of 30° to the horizontal. The length of the string is:
questions.solution: Let the length of the string be L. The height is the vertical component: L × sin 30° = 150. Since sin 30° = 1/2, we get L × (1/2) = 150, so L = 300 m. Therefore option (B) is correct.

questions.text: 20 cm लंबे तार के एक टुकड़े को 60/π cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की एक चाप के रूप में मोड़ा गया। इस वृत्त के केन्द्र पर चाप द्वारा अंतरित कोण है:
questions.text_english: A piece of wire 20 cm long is bent into the form of an arc of a circle of radius 60/π cm. The angle subtended by the arc at the centre of the circle is:
questions.solution: Arc length l = rθ (in radians), where r = 60/π and l = 20. So θ = l/r = 20/(60/π) = 20π/60 = π/3 radians. Converting to degrees: θ = (π/3) × (180/π) = 60°. Therefore the angle is 60°, and option (B) is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): 1 से 20 तक की संख्याओं में से यादृच्छया एक संख्या चुनने की प्रायिकता 1 है।
तर्क (R): किसी घटना E के लिए, यदि P(E) = 1 है, तो E एक निश्चित घटना होती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The probability of selecting a number at random from the numbers 1 to 20 is 1.
Reason (R): For any event E, if P(E) = 1, then E is called a sure event.
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। सही उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given, one labelled Assertion (A) and the other Reason (R). Select the correct answer.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A): When selecting a number at random from 1 to 20, the sample space has 20 outcomes, and all 20 numbers are included, so the probability of selecting any of the numbers 1 to 20 is 20/20 = 1. This is true. Reason (R): By definition, if P(E) = 1, the event E is called a sure (certain) event. This is also true. Moreover, Reason (R) correctly explains why Assertion (A) gives probability 1 — because selecting a number from 1 to 20 is a sure event. Therefore option (A) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है क्योंकि 1 से 20 में से कोई भी संख्या चुनी जाएगी, अतः प्रायिकता = 20/20 = 1। तर्क (R) भी सत्य है और यह अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): यदि हम समान त्रिज्या वाले दो अर्धगोलों को उनके आधारों से जोड़ते हैं, तो हमें एक गोला प्राप्त होता है।
तर्क (R): r त्रिज्या वाले गोले का संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 3πr² होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If we join two hemispheres of same radius along their bases, then we get a sphere.
Reason (R): Total Surface Area of a sphere of radius r is 3πr².
questions.instruction_line: सही उत्तर कोड (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A): Joining two hemispheres of the same radius along their flat circular bases does indeed form a complete sphere. This statement is true. Reason (R): The total surface area of a sphere of radius r is 4πr², not 3πr². So Reason (R) is false. Therefore Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false, making option (C) correct.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है — दो समान अर्धगोले जोड़ने पर गोला बनता है। परंतु तर्क (R) असत्य है क्योंकि गोले का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 4πr² होता है, 3πr² नहीं। अतः विकल्प (C) सही है।

sub_questions.text: यदि x cos 60° + y cos 0° + sin 30° − cot 45° = 5 है, तो x + 2y का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If x cos 60° + y cos 0° + sin 30° − cot 45° = 5, then find the value of x + 2y.

key_points: Substitute standard values: cos 60° = 1/2, cos 0° = 1, sin 30° = 1/2, cot 45° = 1

sub_questions.solution: Substituting standard trigonometric values: cos 60° = 1/2, cos 0° = 1, sin 30° = 1/2, cot 45° = 1. The equation becomes: x(1/2) + y(1) + 1/2 − 1 = 5 → x/2 + y − 1/2 = 5 → x/2 + y = 5 + 1/2 = 11/2. Multiplying both sides by 2: x + 2y = 11.

sub_questions.text: tan²60° / (sin²60° + cos²30°) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Evaluate: tan²60° / (sin²60° + cos²30°)
sub_questions.solution: Using standard values: tan 60° = √3, so tan²60° = 3. Also sin 60° = √3/2, so sin²60° = 3/4, and cos 30° = √3/2, so cos²30° = 3/4. Therefore: tan²60° / (sin²60° + cos²30°) = 3 / (3/4 + 3/4) = 3 / (6/4) = 3 × (4/6) = 2.

questions.solution: This question has two internal choice options (a) and (b). Attempt any one. See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text: बहुपद p(x) = x² + (4/3)x − 4/3 के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = x² + (4/3)x − 4/3.
questions.solution: We need to find the zeroes of p(x) = x² + (4/3)x − 4/3. Multiplying by 3: 3x² + 4x − 4 = 0. Factorizing: 3x² + 6x − 2x − 4 = 0 → 3x(x + 2) − 2(x + 2) = 0 → (3x − 2)(x + 2) = 0. Therefore x = 2/3 or x = −2. The zeroes of the polynomial are 2/3 and −2.
questions.topic: Finding zeroes of a quadratic polynomial

questions.text: एक वृत्त के केंद्र के निर्देशांक (2a, a − 7) हैं। यदि यह वृत्त बिंदु (11, −9) से होकर जाता है तथा इसका व्यास 10√2 इकाई है, तो 'a' का/के मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The coordinates of the centre of a circle are (2a, a − 7). Find the value(s) of 'a' if the circle passes through the point (11, −9) and has diameter 10√2 units.

key_points: Distance from centre to point = radius: √[(11−2a)² + (−9−(a−7))²] = 5√2

questions.solution: The radius = diameter/2 = 10√2/2 = 5√2. Since the circle passes through (11, −9) and has centre (2a, a − 7), the distance equals the radius: √[(11 − 2a)² + (−9 − (a − 7))²] = 5√2. Squaring: (11 − 2a)² + (−2 − a)² = 50. Expanding: (121 − 44a + 4a²) + (4 + 4a + a²) = 50 → 5a² − 40a + 125 = 50 → 5a² − 40a + 75 = 0 → a² − 8a + 15 = 0 → (a − 3)(a − 5) = 0. Therefore a = 3 or a = 5.

sub_questions.text: यदि △ABC ~ △PQR है जिसमें AB = 6 cm, BC = 4 cm, AC = 8 cm तथा PR = 6 cm हैं, तो (PQ + QR) की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If △ABC ~ △PQR in which AB = 6 cm, BC = 4 cm, AC = 8 cm and PR = 6 cm, then find the length of (PQ + QR).
sub_questions.solution: Since △ABC ~ △PQR, corresponding sides are proportional. The correspondence is A↔P, B↔Q, C↔R. The ratio of similarity = PR/AC = 6/8 = 3/4. Therefore PQ/AB = 3/4 → PQ = (3/4) × 6 = 4.5 cm, and QR/BC = 3/4 → QR = (3/4) × 4 = 3 cm. Hence PQ + QR = 4.5 + 3 = 7.5 cm.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, QR/QS = QT/PR तथा ∠1 = ∠2 है, तो दर्शाइए कि △PQS ~ △TQR।
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, QR/QS = QT/PR and ∠1 = ∠2, show that △PQS ~ △TQR.

key_points: Since ∠1 = ∠2, triangle QPR is isosceles, so QP = PR
Substituting QP for PR: QR/QS = QT/QP
In △PQS and △TQR: QR/QS = QT/QP and ∠Q is common

sub_questions.solution: Given ∠1 = ∠2, i.e., ∠PQR = ∠QPR. In triangle QPR, since two angles are equal, the triangle is isosceles, so QP = PR. Now substituting QP for PR in the given condition QR/QS = QT/PR: we get QR/QS = QT/QP, which rearranges to QP/QS = QT/QR. In triangles PQS and TQR, the angle at Q is common (∠PQS = ∠TQR = ∠Q). Since QP/QS = QT/QR and the included angle ∠Q is equal, by SAS similarity criterion, △PQS ~ △TQR. (Proved)

questions.solution: This question has two internal choice options (a) and (b). Attempt any one. See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text: एक व्यक्ति एक वृत्ताकार मैदान के केंद्र से 26 m की दूरी पर स्थित एक बाह्य बिंदु P पर खड़ा है। वह देखता है कि मैदान के दो बिंदुओं A तथा B से उसकी दूरी 10 m है (PA और PB वृत्त पर स्पर्श-रेखाएँ हैं)। वृत्ताकार मैदान की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: A person is standing at P outside a circular ground at a distance of 26 m from the centre of the ground. He found that his distances from the points A and B on the ground are 10 m (PA and PB are tangents to the circle). Find the radius of the circular ground.

key_points: PA is tangent, OA is radius, so OA ⊥ PA → right angle at A
In right triangle OAP: OA² + PA² = OP²

questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. Point P is outside the circle. PA and PB are tangents to the circle from P, each of length 10 m. OP = 26 m.
questions.solution: Since PA is a tangent to the circle at A, and OA is the radius, we have OA ⊥ PA. Therefore triangle OAP is a right-angled triangle with the right angle at A. Using the Pythagoras theorem: OA² + PA² = OP² → r² + (10)² = (26)² → r² + 100 = 676 → r² = 576 → r = 24 m. The radius of the circular ground is 24 m.
questions.solution_hindi: PA स्पर्श-रेखा है, अतः OA ⊥ PA। पाइथागोरस प्रमेय से: r² + 100 = 676 → r² = 576 → r = 24 m।

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, O वृत्त का केंद्र है तथा BCD बिंदु C पर स्पर्श-रेखा है। सिद्ध कीजिए कि ∠BAC + ∠ACD = 90°।
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, O is the centre of the circle and BCD is tangent to it at C. Prove that ∠BAC + ∠ACD = 90°.

key_points: In triangle OAC, OA = OC (radii), so ∠OAC = ∠OCA
Using angle sum and tangent properties, ∠BAC + ∠ACD = 90°

sub_questions.solution: Since BCD is tangent to the circle at C, and OC is the radius, OC ⊥ BCD, so ∠OCD = 90°. This gives ∠OCA + ∠ACD = 90°. In triangle OAC, OA = OC (both radii), so triangle OAC is isosceles, and ∠OAC = ∠OCA. Since ∠BAC = ∠OAC (same angle), we have ∠BAC = ∠OCA. Substituting: ∠BAC + ∠ACD = ∠OCA + ∠ACD = 90°. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि वृत्त के परिगत बने चतुर्भुज की आमने-सामने की (सम्मुख) भुजाएँ वृत्त के केंद्र पर संपूरक कोण अंतरित करती हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that opposite sides of a quadrilateral circumscribing a circle subtend supplementary angles at the centre of the circle.

key_points: Let the quadrilateral ABCD circumscribe a circle with centre O, touching at P, Q, R, S
Join OP, OQ, OR, OS dividing the quadrilateral into triangles
The angles subtended by AB and CD at O, and by BC and AD at O are supplementary

sub_questions.solution: Let quadrilateral ABCD circumscribe a circle with centre O, touching the sides AB, BC, CD, DA at points P, Q, R, S respectively. Join O to A, B, C, D, P, Q, R, S. Triangles OAP and OAS are congruent (tangent lengths from external point are equal, and OA is common), so ∠AOP = ∠AOS. Similarly, ∠BOP = ∠BOQ, ∠COQ = ∠COR, ∠DOR = ∠DOS. The sum of all eight angles = 360°. So ∠AOB + ∠COD = (∠AOP + ∠BOP) + (∠COR + ∠DOR) = half of 360° = 180°. Similarly ∠BOC + ∠AOD = 180°. Hence opposite sides subtend supplementary angles at the centre. (Proved)

questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. A chord AC is drawn inside the circle. Point P is on the circle. BCD is a tangent to the circle at C. B and D are points on the tangent line on either side of C.
questions.solution: This question has two internal choice options (a) and (b). Attempt any one. See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि: tan θ / (1 − cot θ) + cot θ / (1 − tan θ) = 1 + sec θ cosec θ
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that: tan θ / (1 − cot θ) + cot θ / (1 − tan θ) = 1 + sec θ cosec θ

key_points: Express tan and cot in terms of sin and cos
Simplify the LHS by finding a common denominator
Show LHS simplifies to 1 + 1/(sin θ cos θ) = 1 + sec θ cosec θ

sub_questions.solution: LHS = tan θ/(1 − cot θ) + cot θ/(1 − tan θ). Let t = tan θ, so cot θ = 1/t. LHS = t/(1 − 1/t) + (1/t)/(1 − t) = t/((t−1)/t) + (1/t)/(1−t) = t²/(t−1) + (1/t)(1/(1−t)) = t²/(t−1) − 1/(t(t−1)) = (t³ − 1)/(t(t−1)) = (t−1)(t²+t+1)/(t(t−1)) = (t²+t+1)/t = t + 1 + 1/t = tan θ + 1 + cot θ = 1 + (sin θ/cos θ) + (cos θ/sin θ) = 1 + (sin²θ + cos²θ)/(sin θ cos θ) = 1 + 1/(sin θ cos θ) = 1 + sec θ cosec θ = RHS. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि: (sin A + cos A)/(sin A − cos A) + (sin A − cos A)/(sin A + cos A) = 2/(2 sin²A − 1)
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that: (sin A + cos A)/(sin A − cos A) + (sin A − cos A)/(sin A + cos A) = 2/(2 sin²A − 1)

key_points: Combine LHS using common denominator (sin A − cos A)(sin A + cos A)
Numerator becomes (sin A + cos A)² + (sin A − cos A)²

sub_questions.solution: LHS = (sin A + cos A)/(sin A − cos A) + (sin A − cos A)/(sin A + cos A). Taking common denominator: = [(sin A + cos A)² + (sin A − cos A)²] / [(sin A − cos A)(sin A + cos A)]. Numerator = (sin²A + 2sinA cosA + cos²A) + (sin²A − 2sinA cosA + cos²A) = 1 + 2sinA cosA + 1 − 2sinA cosA = 2. Denominator = sin²A − cos²A = sin²A − (1 − sin²A) = 2sin²A − 1. Therefore LHS = 2/(2sin²A − 1) = RHS. Hence proved.

questions.solution: This question has two internal choice options (a) and (b). Attempt any one. See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text: वह अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें y-अक्ष बिंदुओं (5, −6) तथा (−1, −4) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को विभाजित करता है। प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदु भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the ratio in which the y-axis divides the line segment joining the points (5, −6) and (−1, −4). Also find the point of intersection.

key_points: Let y-axis divide the segment in ratio k:1
x-coordinate of division point = 0 (on y-axis): (k×(−1) + 1×5)/(k+1) = 0 → k = 5

questions.solution: Let the y-axis divide the segment joining (5, −6) and (−1, −4) in the ratio k:1. By the section formula, the x-coordinate of the dividing point is (k × (−1) + 1 × 5)/(k + 1) = (−k + 5)/(k + 1). Since the point lies on the y-axis, this x-coordinate = 0: −k + 5 = 0 → k = 5. So the ratio is 5:1. The y-coordinate = (5 × (−4) + 1 × (−6))/(5 + 1) = (−20 − 6)/6 = −26/6 = −13/3. The point of intersection is (0, −13/3).

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि 1/√5 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that 1/√5 is an irrational number.

key_points: Assume 1/√5 is rational, so 1/√5 = p/q where p, q are integers, q ≠ 0, HCF(p,q) = 1
Then √5 = q/p, which means √5 is rational
But √5 is known to be irrational — contradiction

questions.solution: Assume, for contradiction, that 1/√5 is rational. Then 1/√5 = p/q, where p and q are integers with q ≠ 0 and HCF(p, q) = 1. Rearranging, √5 = q/p. Since p and q are integers and p ≠ 0, q/p is a rational number, which would mean √5 is rational. However, it is a well-known result that √5 is irrational (as 5 is not a perfect square and its prime factorization contains an odd power of 5). This is a contradiction. Therefore our assumption is wrong, and 1/√5 is an irrational number. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: माना 1/√5 परिमेय है, अतः 1/√5 = p/q। तब √5 = q/p परिमेय होगा। परंतु √5 अपरिमेय है — विरोधाभास। अतः 1/√5 अपरिमेय है।
questions.topic: Irrational numbers and proof by contradiction

questions.text: एक कमरा बेलन के आकार का है जिसके ऊपर एक अर्धगोलाकार गुंबद अध्यारोपित है। अर्धगोले के आधार की त्रिज्या, बेलनाकार भाग की ऊँचाई की आधी है। यदि इस कमरे में 1408/21 m³ वायु है, तो बेलनाकार भाग की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए। (π = 22/7 प्रयोग कीजिए)
questions.text_english: A room is in the form of a cylinder surmounted by a hemispherical dome. The base radius of the hemisphere is half of the height of the cylindrical part. If the room contains 1408/21 m³ of air, find the height of the cylindrical part. (Use π = 22/7).

key_points: Let height of cylinder = h, radius r = h/2
Substitute r = h/2 and solve for h = 4 m

questions.solution: Let the height of the cylindrical part be h metres. Then the radius of the hemisphere r = h/2. Total volume = Volume of cylinder + Volume of hemisphere = πr²h + (2/3)πr³ = π(h/2)²h + (2/3)π(h/2)³ = πh³/4 + (2/3)π(h³/8) = πh³/4 + πh³/12 = πh³(3 + 1)/12 = πh³/3. Setting equal to 1408/21: (22/7)(h³/3) = 1408/21 → 22h³/21 = 1408/21 → h³ = 1408/22 = 64 → h = 4 m. The height of the cylindrical part is 4 m.
questions.solution_hindi: माना ऊँचाई h, त्रिज्या r = h/2। कुल आयतन = πr²h + (2/3)πr³ = πh³/3 = 1408/21। हल करने पर h³ = 64 → h = 4 m।

questions.text: दो पासे एक साथ उछाले गए। दोनों पासों पर आई संख्याओं का अन्तर 2 होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Two dice are thrown at the same time. Determine the probability that the difference of the numbers on the two dice is 2.
questions.solution: When two dice are thrown, the total number of outcomes is 6 × 6 = 36. The favourable outcomes where the difference of the two numbers is 2 are: (1, 3), (3, 1), (2, 4), (4, 2), (3, 5), (5, 3), (4, 6), (6, 4) — a total of 8 outcomes. Therefore the probability = 8/36 = 2/9.
questions.topic: Probability of events with two dice

questions.text: विजय ने दो योजनाओं A तथा B में, जो क्रमशः 8% वार्षिक तथा 9% वार्षिक ब्याज देती हैं, कुछ-कुछ राशियाँ निवेश कीं। उसे कुल ₹1,860 वार्षिक ब्याज प्राप्त हुआ। यद्यपि, अगर उसने दो योजनाओं में निवेश की राशियों को आपस में बदल दिया होता, तो उसे वार्षिक ब्याज ₹20 अधिक प्राप्त होता। ज्ञात कीजिए कि उसने प्रत्येक योजना में कितनी राशि निवेश की।
questions.text_english: Vijay invested certain amounts of money in two schemes A and B, which offer interest at the rate of 8% per annum and 9% per annum, respectively. He received ₹1,860 as the total annual interest. However, had he interchanged the amounts of investments in the two schemes, he would have received ₹20 more as annual interest. How much money did he invest in each scheme?

key_points: Let amount in A = x, amount in B = y

questions.solution: Let the amount invested in scheme A be ₹x and in scheme B be ₹y. From the given conditions: (8/100)x + (9/100)y = 1860, which gives 8x + 9y = 186000 ... (1). After interchanging: (9/100)x + (8/100)y = 1880, which gives 9x + 8y = 188000 ... (2). Adding (1) and (2): 17x + 17y = 374000 → x + y = 22000 ... (3). Subtracting (1) from (2): x − y = 2000 ... (4). From (3) and (4): 2x = 24000 → x = 12000, and y = 10000. Therefore Vijay invested ₹12,000 in scheme A and ₹10,000 in scheme B.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

sub_questions.text: एक समांतर चतुर्भुज ABCD का विकर्ण BD, रेखाखंड AE को बिंदु F पर काटता है, जहाँ E भुजा BC पर स्थित कोई बिंदु है। सिद्ध कीजिए कि DF × EF = FB × FA।
sub_questions.text_english: The diagonal BD of a parallelogram ABCD intersects the line segment AE at the point F, where E is any point on the side BC. Prove that DF × EF = FB × FA.

key_points: In triangles AFD and EFB, show similarity using AA criterion
△AFD ~ △EFB → DF/FB = AF/EF → DF × EF = FB × FA

sub_questions.solution: In parallelogram ABCD, AD ∥ BC. Consider triangles AFD and EFB. ∠AFD = ∠EFB (vertically opposite angles). Since AD ∥ BC, ∠ADF = ∠FBE (alternate interior angles). Therefore by AA similarity criterion, △AFD ~ △EFB. Since the triangles are similar, their corresponding sides are proportional: DF/FB = FA/FE. Cross-multiplying: DF × FE = FB × FA. Hence DF × EF = FB × FA. (Proved)

sub_questions.text: △ABC में, यदि AD ⊥ BC तथा AD² = BD × DC है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि ∠BAC = 90°।
sub_questions.text_english: In △ABC, if AD ⊥ BC and AD² = BD × DC, then prove that ∠BAC = 90°.

key_points: AD² = BD × DC can be rewritten as AD/BD = DC/AD

sub_questions.solution: Given AD ⊥ BC and AD² = BD × DC, i.e., AD/BD = DC/AD. In triangles ADB and CDA: ∠ADB = ∠CDA = 90°, and AD/BD = DC/AD. By SAS similarity, △ADB ~ △CDA. Therefore ∠DAB = ∠DCA and ∠ABD = ∠DAC. Now in right triangle ADB: ∠DAB + ∠ABD = 90°. Substituting: ∠DAB + ∠DAC = 90°, i.e., ∠BAC = 90°. Hence proved.

questions.topic: Similarity of triangles and Pythagoras theorem

sub_questions.text: एक समकोण त्रिभुज का परिमाप 60 cm है तथा इसके कर्ण की लंबाई 25 cm है। त्रिभुज की अन्य दो भुजाओं की लंबाइयाँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The perimeter of a right triangle is 60 cm and its hypotenuse is 25 cm. Find the lengths of other two sides of the triangle.

key_points: Let the two sides be a and b. Then a + b + 25 = 60 → a + b = 35
Solve: a and b are roots of t² − 35t + 300 = 0 → (t−15)(t−20) = 0 → a = 15, b = 20

sub_questions.solution: Let the two legs of the right triangle be a and b, and the hypotenuse = 25 cm. From the perimeter: a + b + 25 = 60, so a + b = 35. By the Pythagoras theorem: a² + b² = 25² = 625. Using (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²: 35² = 625 + 2ab → 1225 − 625 = 2ab → ab = 300. Now a and b are roots of the quadratic t² − (a+b)t + ab = 0, i.e., t² − 35t + 300 = 0 → (t − 15)(t − 20) = 0 → t = 15 or t = 20. The two sides are 15 cm and 20 cm.

sub_questions.text: एक रेलगाड़ी 480 km की दूरी एकसमान चाल से तय करती है। यदि इसकी चाल 8 km/h कम होती, तो इसे वही दूरी तय करने में 3 घंटे अधिक लगते। रेलगाड़ी की चाल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: A train travels a distance of 480 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 8 km/h less, then it would have taken 3 hours more to cover the same distance. Find the speed of the train.

key_points: Let speed = x km/h. Time at speed x = 480/x, time at (x−8) = 480/(x−8)

sub_questions.solution: Let the speed of the train be x km/h. Time taken at speed x = 480/x hours, and time taken at speed (x − 8) = 480/(x − 8) hours. Given: 480/(x − 8) − 480/x = 3. Simplifying: 480[x − (x−8)] / [x(x−8)] = 3 → 480 × 8 = 3x(x−8) → 3840 = 3x² − 24x → x² − 8x − 1280 = 0. Factorizing: (x − 40)(x + 32) = 0. Since speed cannot be negative, x = 40 km/h. The speed of the train is 40 km/h.

questions.solution: This question has two internal choice options (a) and (b). Attempt any one. See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित सारणी में लुप्त बारंबारता 'f' ज्ञात कीजिए, यदि दिए गए आँकड़ों का माध्य 18 है। अतः आँकड़ों का बहुलक ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the missing frequency 'f' in the following table, if the mean of the given data is 18. Hence find the mode.

key_points: Using the mean formula: Σfixi / Σfi = 18

questions.image_description: A frequency distribution table with Daily Allowance intervals (11-13, 13-15, 15-17, 17-19, 19-21, 21-23, 23-25) and corresponding number of children (7, 6, 9, 13, f, 5, 4).
questions.solution: The class midpoints are: 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24. Using the mean formula: Σfixi / Σfi = 18. Calculating Σfixi = 7×12 + 6×14 + 9×16 + 13×18 + f×20 + 5×22 + 4×24 = 84 + 84 + 144 + 234 + 20f + 110 + 96 = 752 + 20f. Total frequency Σfi = 7 + 6 + 9 + 13 + f + 5 + 4 = 44 + f. Setting up the equation: (752 + 20f)/(44 + f) = 18 → 752 + 20f = 792 + 18f → 2f = 40 → f = 20. For the mode, the class with the highest frequency is 17–19 with frequency 13. But wait, with f = 20, the class 19–21 has frequency 20 which is highest. Modal class = 19–21. Mode = 19 + [(20 − 13)/(2×20 − 13 − 5)] × 2 = 19 + [7/22] × 2 = 19 + 14/22 = 19 + 7/11 ≈ 19.64.
questions.topic: Mean and Mode of grouped data

questions.text: एक विद्यालय स्थानीय अस्पताल के लिए धन जुटाने हेतु चैरिटी दौड़ का आयोजन कर रहा है। दौड़ की योजना एक ट्रैक के चारों ओर कई चक्करों की श्रृंखला के रूप में बनाई गई है, जिसमें प्रत्येक चक्कर 300 मीटर का होगा। इस आयोजन को और अधिक चुनौतीपूर्ण और आकर्षक बनाने के लिए, आयोजकों ने अगले प्रत्येक चक्कर की दूरी को 50 मीटर बढ़ाने का फैसला किया। उदाहरण के लिए, दूसरा चक्कर 350 मीटर, तीसरा चक्कर 400 मीटर और इसी प्रकार आगे। योजनाबद्ध चक्करों की कुल संख्या 10 है।
questions.text_english: A school is organizing a charity run to raise funds for a local hospital. The run is planned as a series of rounds around a track, with each round being 300 metres. To make the event more challenging and engaging, the organizers decide to increase the distance of each subsequent round by 50 metres. For example, the second round will be 350 metres, the third round will be 400 metres and so on. The total number of rounds planned is 10.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: इस प्रकार बनी समांतर श्रेढ़ी का चौथा, पाँचवाँ तथा छठा पद लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the fourth, fifth and sixth term of the Arithmetic Progression so formed.
sub_questions.solution: The AP formed has first term a = 300 and common difference d = 50. The nth term = a + (n−1)d. 4th term = 300 + 3×50 = 450 m, 5th term = 300 + 4×50 = 500 m, 6th term = 300 + 5×50 = 550 m.

sub_questions.text: 8वें चक्कर में तय की गई दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Determine the distance of the 8th round.
sub_questions.solution: The 8th term of the AP = a + (8−1)d = 300 + 7 × 50 = 300 + 350 = 650 metres.

sub_questions.text: 10 चक्कर पूरे करने पर तय की गई कुल दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the total distance run after completing all 10 rounds.

sub_questions.text: यदि एक दौड़ने वाला केवल पहले 6 चक्कर पूरे कर पाए, तो उसके द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If a runner completes only the first 6 rounds, what is the total distance run by the runner?

questions.solution: This is a case study question. Refer to sub_questions for individual solutions.
questions.topic: nth term and sum of AP

questions.text:
ब्रोच एक सजावटी वस्तु है जिसे अक्सर जैकेट, ब्लाउज या ड्रेस जैसे कपड़ों पर पहना जाता है ताकि सुंदरता बढ़ाई जा सके। बहुमूल्य धातुओं से निर्मित और रत्नों से सुसज्जित, ब्रोच कई आकार और डिज़ाइन में आते हैं।

एक ऐसे वृत्ताकार ब्रोच को चाँदी के तार से बनाया गया है, जिसका व्यास 35 mm है। तार को वृत्त के 5 व्यासों को बनाने में भी प्रयुक्त किया गया है, जो उसे 10 बराबर त्रिज्यखंडों में विभाजित करता है, जैसा कि आकृति में दर्शाया गया है।
questions.text_english:
A brooch is a decorative piece often worn on clothing like jackets, blouses or dresses to add elegance. Made from precious metals and decorated with gemstones, brooches come in many shapes and designs.

One such brooch is made with silver wire in the form of a circle with diameter 35 mm. The wire is also used in making 5 diameters which divide the circle into 10 equal sectors as shown in the figure.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above given information, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: प्रत्येक त्रिज्यखंड का केंद्रीय कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the central angle of each sector.
sub_questions.solution: The circle is divided into 10 equal sectors. Central angle of each sector = 360°/10 = 36°.

sub_questions.text: चाप ACB की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of the arc ACB.

key_points: Arc ACB spans 2 sectors (from figure), central angle = 2 × 36° = 72°

sub_questions.solution: The arc ACB spans 2 sectors (central angle = 72°). Radius r = 35/2 = 17.5 mm. Arc length = (θ/360°) × 2πr = (72/360) × 2 × (22/7) × 17.5 = (1/5) × 2 × 22/7 × 17.5 = (1/5) × 110 = 22 mm.

sub_questions.text: ब्रोच के प्रत्येक त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the area of each sector of the brooch.

sub_questions.text: प्रयोग की गई चाँदी के तार की कुल लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the total length of the silver wire used.
sub_questions.solution: The silver wire is used for the circumference of the circle and for 5 diameters. Circumference = 2πr = 2 × (22/7) × 17.5 = (22/7) × 35 = 110 mm. Length of 5 diameters = 5 × 35 = 175 mm. Total length of silver wire = 110 + 175 = 285 mm.

questions.image_description: A circular brooch divided into 10 equal sectors by 5 diameters. Points A, B, C are marked on the circumference. The circle has diameter 35 mm.
questions.solution: This is a case study question. Refer to sub_questions for individual solutions.
questions.topic: Arc length and area of sector

questions.text: अमृता एक लाइटहाउस के आधार से कुछ दूरी पर खड़ी है तथा इसके शीर्ष को देख रही है। उसने शीर्ष का उन्नयन कोण 60° पाया। तब, वह अपने प्रारंभिक स्थान से निकट 40 मीटर ऊँचे एक अवलोकन डेक पर चढ़ गई तथा वहाँ से उसने लाइटहाउस के शीर्ष का उन्नयन कोण 45° पाया।
questions.text_english: Amrita stood near the base of a lighthouse, gazing up at its towering height. She measured the angle of elevation to the top and found it to be 60°. Then, she climbed a nearby observation deck, 40 metres higher than her original position and noticed the angle of elevation to the top of lighthouse to be 45°.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above given information, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: यदि CD की लंबाई h मीटर है, तो 'h' के पदों में दूरी BD ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If CD is h metres, find the distance BD in terms of 'h'.

key_points: From the observation deck B, angle of elevation to top C is 45°

sub_questions.solution: From point B (observation deck), the angle of elevation to the top C of the lighthouse is 45°. In right triangle BCD: tan 45° = CD/BD = h/BD. Since tan 45° = 1, we get BD = h metres.

sub_questions.text: 'h' के पदों में दूरी BC ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find distance BC in terms of 'h'.

key_points: In right triangle BCD with BD = h and CD = h, using Pythagoras: BC = √(h² + h²) = h√2

sub_questions.solution: In right triangle BCD, BD = h and CD = h (from part i). By Pythagoras theorem: BC² = BD² + CD² = h² + h² = 2h². Therefore BC = h√2 metres.

sub_questions.text: लाइटहाउस की ऊँचाई CE ज्ञात कीजिए। [√3 = 1.73 प्रयोग कीजिए]
sub_questions.text_english: Find the height CE of the lighthouse [Use √3 = 1.73]

key_points: AE = BD = h (horizontally same distance from lighthouse)
From A, angle of elevation = 60°: tan 60° = CE/AE → √3 = CE/h → CE = h√3

sub_questions.solution: Let the horizontal distance AE = BD = h (same horizontal distance). From point A, angle of elevation to top C = 60°: tan 60° = CE/AE → CE = h√3. CE = CD + DE = h + 40 (since DE = AB = 40 m). So h√3 = h + 40 → h(√3 − 1) = 40 → h = 40/(√3 − 1) = 40(√3 + 1)/[(√3)² − 1²] = 40(√3 + 1)/2 = 20(√3 + 1). CE = h√3 = 20√3(√3 + 1) = 20(3 + √3) = 60 + 20√3. Using √3 = 1.73: CE = 60 + 20×1.73 = 60 + 34.6 = 94.6 m.

sub_questions.text: यदि AC = 100 m है, तो दूरी AE ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find distance AE, if AC = 100 m.

key_points: In right triangle ACE (right angle at E): sin 60° = CE/AC

sub_questions.solution: In right triangle ACE with the right angle at E (E is at ground level directly below the lighthouse top), the angle of elevation from A to C is 60°. Given AC = 100 m: AE = AC × cos 60° = 100 × (1/2) = 50 m. Therefore the distance AE is 50 metres.

D is the foot of the perpendicular from B to the lighthouse (same height as B). Angle of elevation from A to C is 60° and from B to C is 45°. CD = h metres is the portion of lighthouse above the observation deck level.
